visual_enhancers.cursor_effects: Custom reactive cursor with magnet/repel effect on hero fragments and interactive cards

motion.core_concept: RAW (high entropy, high chaos, ember orange) → HEAT → SORT → SHAPE → TEMPER → RESULT (low entropy, high structure, temper blue-violet)
patterns: cursor-reactive fragment field repel/attract in Hero
scroll-driven SVG path drawing for system diagrams
interactive before/after morphing case study cards
staggered grid snapping and component reordering on scroll

stages.name: RAW
stages.state: Fragments, noise, high entropy, subtle ember orange highlights

stages.name: HEAT
stages.state: Research fragments, irrelevant noise disappears, heat intensity rises

stages.name: SORT
stages.state: WHAT MATTERS vs WHAT DOESN'T, clutter shrinks, key signals amplify

stages.name: SHAPE
stages.state: Chaotic rectangles snap into responsive grid wireframe & components

stages.name: TEMPER
stages.state: Testing speed, SEO, mobile, conversion; first appearance of Temper Blue-Violet (#4A5FE8)

stages.name: RESULT
stages.state: LESS NOISE. MORE BUSINESS. Complete system resolution with total calm & stability

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive buttons, links, navigation items, inputs, and key indicators MUST include data-testid in kebab-case

general_ui_ux_guidelines: No generic centered templates. Rely on asymmetric Swiss grid alignment.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without backdrop-blur filters for floating nav or headers.
Maintain strict color semantic usage: Ember Orange (#FF4A1C) for active/heat, Temper Blue-Violet (#4A5FE8) for finished/resolved state.
All text must strictly use Manrope font family with high weight contrast.
Ensure high contrast compliance (APCA / WCAG AA) for all text against dark off-black surfaces.
